training_lambda: one Uniform(2,8) latent per episode, fixed across 36 weeks
common_random_numbers: same scenario, lambda, demand seed/draws, parameter draws, and counterparty streams within each group

buckets.canonical_held_out_step: both retailers use classic 4 through week 4 and 8 from week 5; never trained or tuned
buckets.shifted_mean_doubled_variance: seeded NB(r=10,p=.5), mean 10 and variance 20 per retailer
buckets.burst_and_collapse: Poisson rate 4, then frozen seed-derived rate-12 burst, immediately followed by rate-1 collapse

selection: two-update endpoint fixed in advance; no evaluation bucket selects a checkpoint
training_reward: negative local wholesaler return-to-go only; system/team cost is reporting-only
